does: Cooks food with the dry, even heat of an oven.
how: Heat the oven fully before the food goes in.
Set the dish on the middle shelf, with space around it for the air to move.
Leave the door shut for the first part of the cooking.
Turn the dish if the oven browns one side faster, and check before the time is up.

cues.text: An even colour across the top, with the edges just darker than the middle.
A toasty smell that reaches the next room is the sign to check.

mistakes.mistake: Putting food into an oven that is still heating, so that it dries out before it colours.
mistakes.fix: Wait until the oven has reached its heat.
Ovens run hot or cold. Learn yours, and judge by colour and feel as well as by time.
